name: Anime Town Pensacola
blurb: A stop of the Anime Town multi-city tour at the Pensacola Interstate Fairgrounds, billed as the Florida Panhandle's premier anime convention.
notes: Own page ('Anime Town Pensacola takes place May 8-10, 2026 at the Pensacola Interstate Fair') shows an edition that already concluded before this check (2026-10-05). The brand's main animetowncons.com homepage tags Pensacola's next date as '2027 TBA', so no exact 2027 date has been announced yet. Part of the multi-city Anime Town tour — see the Greenville, Huntsville, Biloxi and Louisiana/Bossier City files for the other stops.
